prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.ai** is a good starting point if you want ongoing tracking without paying for a full SEO suite. It monitors whether your business appears in AI answers, including ChatGPT, and can track mentions and citations. Entry plans have been reported around **$29/month**, though check its current prompt limits and pricing before subscribing.

If you only want a quick, free check, try **HubSpot’s AI Search Grader**. It gives a one-time snapshot of how ChatGPT and other AI tools describe your business, but it won’t track changes over time.

A practical approach: start with the free snapshot, then use a paid tracker if you want to monitor a set of realistic customer questions regularly. These tools sample prompts; they can’t guarantee what every person will see, since AI answers vary by wording, location, and time.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
